book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book informs concepts and teaching structure; notes, numerical examples and short checks are independently written. No textbook exercises or artwork are copied.

syllabus.current: 2026–2027, Version 5, as retrieved from the official PDF
syllabus.notes: Central tendency, grouped and coded totals, and combining at most two data sets are included. The uploaded chapter also contains variation and representation questions; these are retained with explicit prerequisites rather than silently removed.

conventions.variance: Descriptive variance uses divisor n, not n−1.
conventions.rounding: Give non-exact numerical answers to 3 significant figures; keep unrounded intermediate totals. Exact equivalent answers are accepted.
conventions.quartiles: For ungrouped data: medians of the lower and upper halves, excluding the overall middle observation when n is odd. This is stated as a bank convention, not an assertion that all published papers use one convention.
conventions.grouped_data: Use class midpoints for mean and standard-deviation estimates. Median interpolation assumes uniform within-class spread, stated when required.
conventions.summaries: All stated summary values are exact unless explicitly described as estimates.

sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only; written reasoning, final-answer rounding judgement and method marks use the existing manual/teacher workflow.
